Question Explanation – Match IUD types with examples and actions.

Concept – Types of IUDs and their functions

Solution –

  • A: Non-medicated IUDs → c (Lippes loop) → ii (Phagocytosis of sperm)
    • Foreign-body reaction in uterus increases leukocyte activity, leading to sperm phagocytosis.
  • B: Copper releasing IUDs → a (Multiload 375) → iii (Suppress sperm motility)
    • Copper ions impair sperm motility and viability.
  • C: Hormone releasing IUDs → d (LNG-20) → i (Uterus unsuitable for implantation)
    • Levonorgestrel causes endometrial changes and thickens cervical mucus.
  • D: Weekly oral pill → b (Saheli) → iv (Anti-estrogenic activity)
    • Centchroman has anti-estrogenic effects and is taken weekly.

Correct mapping: A-c-ii, B-a-iii, C-d-i, D-b-iv.

Final Answer – Option 3

Question Explanation:Identifying the correct sequence of the male genital tract.

Concept:Male Reproductive Tract.

Solution:

The male genital tract is a series of ducts that transport sperm from the testes to the outside of the body.
Sperm are produced in the seminiferous tubules, then move to the Rete testis, followed by the Vasa efferentia.
From there, they enter the Epididymis for maturation and storage. They then travel through the Vas deferens to the ejaculatory duct,
which merges with the Urethra for expulsion.

Final Answer: Option (1)

Seminiferous tubules → Rete testis → Vasa efferentia → Epididymis → Vas deferens → Urethra

Corpus luteum is the structure formed after the release of an egg from a mature follicle (ovulation). It is the remnant of the ruptured follicle.

The primary function of the corpus luteum is to secrete progesterone. Progesterone plays a crucial role in preparing the endometrium (lining of the uterus) for the implantation of a fertilized egg. It also helps maintain the pregnancy.
The correct answer is Option 2:
C-Corpus luteum-Secrete Progesterone."
